fix.message: The exploded-view look module is not used: start from scripts/new-lesson.mjs.

note.message: No look.row: lay the parts on one axis in assembly order with look.row, so they come apart and seat back (references/recipes.md, The row).
No numbered callouts: name each part with look.callouts(row, names) (one ink-blue tag straight above each part).
Fewer than 3 grabbable parts: wire row.hands(traits, isGrabbed, { ... }) so the learner can pull every part out of the row and put it back.
No seat-back behaviour: a part let go near its place should slide home with a click and the lesson should react (row.hands onSeat / onOut, references/teaching.md).
No real size: the object is enlarged, so return real: { size: largest / ENLARGE } and say 'shown N x real size' on the panel (references/teaching.md, True numbers).
Nothing shows what travels through the parts: trace the current, force, air or ink with look.powerPath (or kit.arrow) so the learner sees how the parts work together.
